verdict.headline: FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186) is running a PowerShell C2 implant beaconing to an external server.
verdict.basis: Proven and handed to incident response: survived the argue-the-null pass on 4 corroborating source systems.

narrative.summary: The hunt confirmed that a single workstation, FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186), logged in as AzureAD\FyodorMalteskesko, was running a PowerShell-based command-and-control implant on 2018-08-20. The case was handed to incident response.
narrative.what_happened:
## One operation on FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186), user AzureAD\FyodorMalteskesko

Network flow telemetry (ev-1959b100cde1) recorded **3,884 TCP connections from 192.168.70.186 to 45.77.53.176:443** between 10:01 and 11:59 UTC.

explanations.claim: FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186) is running a PowerShell C2 implant beaconing to an external server.
explanations.reason: survived the argue-the-null pass on 4 corroborating source system(s)

explanations.claim: the activity described in "FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186) is running a PowerShell C2 implant beaconing to an external server." has a legitimate explanation and is not adversary action
explanations.reason: abandoned: Ruled out by sensor-attested telemetry.

evidence.claim: FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186) made 3884 TCP connections to external 45.77.53.176:443 over ~2h (2018-08-20 10:01-11:59 UTC).
evidence.why: One external IP accounts for ~99% of the host's TCP connection count, at a steady high rate for 2 hours.

evidence.claim: Every sampled TCP connection to 45.77.53.176:443 shows refused=1 and a fixed TLS ClientHello; the server never completes the handshake.
C:\Windows\Temp\hdoor.exe on FYODOR-L was spawned by powershell.exe and scanned the internal 192.168.9.0/24 range.

next_steps.text: Isolate FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186) and kill powershell.exe — Sysmon attributes 3,849 beacon connections to 45.77.53.176 to that process over 10:01–11:59 UTC.
Block egress to 45.77.53.176 (ports 443, 3333, 8088) — hardcoded external C2 with no DNS, unknown to current feeds.

escalations.rationale: FYODOR-L (192.168.70.186), user AzureAD\FyodorMalteskesko, is running a PowerShell C2 implant.

steps.text: hdoor.exe is a scanning tool spawned by powershell.exe on FYODOR-L, run against the internal 192.168.9.0/24 range.
The board is fully resolved: h-c27d2fe9 proven and handed off to IR; h-6c858dc9 abandoned.
